result.instruction: Replace the up-counter phase state with an 8-bit complemented phase state, reset it to `8'hFF`, and decrement it each active clock so its complemented value follows the original 0–255 sequence. Drive the registered `pwm_out` from the comparison of that complemented phase with `duty`, preserving the current-cycle comparison and synchronous reset behavior. Keep the interface and registered output timing unchanged; promotion still requires all verification gates, routed WNS and WHS at least zero, and strictly fewer LUTs than the 7-LUT incumbent.
